description:
At T-Mobile, we invest in YOU!  Our Total Rewards Package ensures that employees get the same big love we give our customers.  All team members receive a competitive base salary and compensation package - this is Total Rewards. Employees enjoy multiple wealth-building opportunities through our annual stock grant, employee stock purchase plan, 401(k), and access to free, year-round money coaches. That’s how we’re UNSTOPPABLE for our employees! 
 
 
Job Overview
T-Mobile Home Internet is one of our fastest growing businesses, and the software this team builds runs on every gateway and mesh extender we put in a customer's home. We're a small development team on a large program, so you'll contribute to meaningful software development work from the start.
 
You'll develop the device agents that manage, monitor, and troubleshoot our broadband customer premises equipment. They're written in C and C++ against the Broadband Forum's open USP standards and run on the RDK-B platform. The agent uses a microservice architecture, and you'll develop and maintain assigned services within the established architecture.
 
Your agents will interface with the device's Wi-Fi and cellular subsystems through RDK and RBUS. You won't be writing Wi-Fi drivers or modem firmware, but understanding those technologies, and how RDK components talk to each other, is central to doing this job well. 
 
 What you'll do 
 Develop and maintain one or more microservices within the device management agent, in C and C++ on RDK-B.
 Implement and maintain device data model parameters and USP protocol behavior across supported hardware platforms.
 Interface with the device's Wi-Fi and cellular subsystems through RDK and RBUS to configure them, query state, and report it upstream.
 Build and maintain the containerized services that run on the device, delivered through a Kubernetes-based packaging and deployment pipeline.
 Write unit tests for new and changed code and extend our automated test coverage.
 Debug across the device software stack, from log analysis and root cause investigation through to fix verification.
 Support device maintenance releases, including test support, firmware validation, and release verification.
 Work with OEM partners on defect triage and reproduction.
 Improve how we collect data and logs from the field so issues can be triaged and resolved faster.
 Contribute ideas that improve how we build, test, and deliver device software.
 Document your code, the data model and device behavior.
   
 Job Summary 
 This role is essential for designing, implementing, and deploying scalable software solutions that meet customer requirements and support high availability environments. The role involves collaborating with engineering teams to develop software components using technologies such as virtualization, microservices, software-defined networking, network functions virtualization, and broadband device management. This position requires independent development of software components and understanding system protocols, data flows, and technology interactions, including those supporting broadband customer premises equipment (CPE). Success is measured by the ability to deliver technical solutions, produce clear documentation, and contribute to technology strategy and innovation. The work impacts the organization by enabling advanced software systems that improve operational efficiency and support business goals.
   
 Main Responsibilities 
 Develop software solutions that support engineering projects and meet customer requirements, including developing and maintaining embedded software components and device management services for broadband CPE.
 Collaborate with technical teams to deliver effective technical solutions and continuously learn new technologies, including supporting software debugging, testing, release verification, and defect investigation with OEM partners.
 Create clear documentation for software code, system designs, and business requirements, including device data models and software behavior.
 Contribute to technology strategy by understanding current technologies and supporting business goals, including improvements to device software testing, diagnostics, and development processes.
 Present innovative ideas to improve systems, processes, or services based on industry research, including improvements to device software reliability and troubleshooting.
 Also responsible for other duties/projects as assigned by business management as needed.
   
 Required Qualifications 
 Bachelor's Degree plus 3 years of related work experience OR advanced degree with 1 year of related work experience OR combination of education and experience deemed equivalent.
 Acceptable areas of study include Computer Science or Engineering.
 2-4 years of technical engineering experience.
   
 Preferred Qualifications 
 Experience with RDK-B and RBUS, or a comparable embedded networking platform and message bus.
 C and C++ development on embedded Linux.
 Strong Wi-Fi knowledge: 802.11 standards and generations, band and channel behavior, client association and steering, and practical troubleshooting.
 Strong grounding in the IP stack and network technologies: TCP/IP, DHCP, DNS, NAT, routing and bridging.
 Working understanding of 5G networks and fixed wireless access.
 Familiarity with TR-069, TR-369 (USP), or TR-181 device management standards.
 Experience writing unit tests and building or extending automated test coverage.
 Experience with containerized applications and delivering packages to embedded devices.
 Proficiency with Git and continuous integration pipelines.
 Hands-on development experience with cellular, Wi-Fi, mesh networking, or other carrier-side telecom products.
 Proficiency in C and C++.
 Working knowledge of networking fundamentals and comfort debugging software you did not write.
   
 Required Knowledge, Skills and Abilities 
 Analytical Thinking
 Collaboration
 Continuous Development
 DevOps
 Emerging Technologies
 Programming Languages
 Software Design
 Software Development
 Technology Development
 Test Evaluation
 
 
 At least 18 years of age
 Legally authorized to work in the United States
 
 Travel :
Travel Required (Yes/No): Yes

 DOT Regulated :
DOT Regulated Position (Yes/No): No
Safety Sensitive Position (Yes/No): No

 
 
Total Target Cash Earnings Opportunity: $106,375 - $191,820 
 
National Base Pay Range: $92,500 - $166,800 
 
 The Total Target Cash Earnings Opportunity represents the expected total cash compensation for this role at target performance, combining base salary and annual incentive opportunity. Actual earnings may be higher or lower depending on individual performance and overall company results.  
 
 
The base pay range reflects the compensation component of this opportunity. The candidate’s actual pay will be based on various factors, such as work location, qualifications, and experience, so the actual starting pay will vary within this range. To find the pay range for this role based on hiring location, https://paylookup.t-mobile.com/paylookup?reqID=REQ377384¶dox=1 
 
 At T-Mobile, employees in regular, non-temporary roles are eligible for an annual bonus or periodic sales incentive or bonus, based on their role. Corporate employees are eligible for a year-end bonus based on individual and/or company performance and which is set at a percentage of the employee’s eligible earnings in the prior year. Certain positions in Customer Care are eligible for monthly bonuses based on individual and/or team performance. The incentive component included in the Total Target Cash Earnings Opportunity reflects target performance. Actual earnings included in the Total Target Cash Earnings Opportunity reflect target performance; actual payouts may vary.  

At T-Mobile, our benefits exemplify the spirit of One Team, Together! A big part of how we care for one another is working to ensure our benefits evolve to meet the needs of our team members. Full and part-time employees have access to the same benefits when eligible. We cover all of the bases, offering medical, dental and vision insurance, a flexible spending account, 401(k), employee stock grants, employee stock purchase plan, paid time off and up to 12 paid holidays - which total about 4 weeks for new full-time employees and about 2.5 weeks for new part-time employees annually - paid parental and family leave, family building benefits, back-up care, enhanced family support, childcare subsidy, tuition assistance, college coaching, short- and long-term disability, voluntary AD&D coverage, voluntary accident coverage, voluntary life insurance, voluntary disability insurance, and voluntary long-term care insurance. We don't stop there - eligible employees can also receive mobile service & home internet discounts, pet insurance, and access to commuter and transit programs! To learn about T-Mobile’s amazing benefits, check out  www.t-mobilebenefits.com . 
 
 
Never stop growing!   
As part of the T-Mobile team, you know the Un-carrier doesn’t have a corporate ladder–it’s more like a jungle gym of possibilities! We love helping our employees grow in their careers, because it’s that shared drive to aim high that drives our business and our culture forward. By applying for this career opportunity, you’re living our values while investing in your career growth–and we applaud it. You’re unstoppable!
